info.title: SORI iPad Exam API
info.description: Personal-practice iPad API with three immutable MusicXML questions (6/8, 4/4, 3/4), local piano playback and asynchronous OpenRouter AI grading and Korean feedback. AI values are estimates; API-CONTRACT.md defines invariants. Legacy v1 fixtures remain for regression checks. Playback v3 adds meter-matched, accented count-ins before both full replays, 20-second writing pauses and a final 120 seconds. Password login uses one persistent, revocable DRF bearer token per user and shared PostgreSQL login limits.

post.summary: Log in with username and password
post.description: Ignores Authorization, including invalid bearer headers. Body limit 32 KiB; then IP rolling limit 30 admitted requests/5 minutes; then input validation; then username block for 5 minutes after five authentication failures/5 minutes. An IP-limited request can only inspect a valid username block, never verify credentials. If both limits apply use the longer remaining delay and ceil Retry-After seconds. Do not automatically retry. No Idempotency-Key. Credentials are not normalized. Profile UUID matches /me/. Concurrent login and credential updates are serialized; password changes and deactivation revoke tokens atomically.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Persist one UUID per logical mutation. Reuse for transport retries; never regenerate on timeout. Scope: user + method + concrete path + key.

source_tempo_bpm.description: Notation tempo for asset validation, independent of playback tempo. Legacy assets default to quarter=96.

tempo_bpm.description: Quarter-note BPM. For dotted-quarter=55 this is exactly 82.5.

PlaybackPlan.description: Immutable v2/v3 attempts retain their original snapshots. New v4 plans carry a meter-specific tempo setting, fractional quarter-note tempo_bpm, a 2- or 3-bar ascending/descending scale and the v2 synthesized piano. Timing pauses and the first/last count-ins retain v3 rules.

image.description: 2660 × 1692 PNG, RGB/RGBA without transparency, white background; maximum 10 MiB.

BBox.description: Top-left origin in the complete answer image. x+width <= 1, y+height <= 1. Width and height must be positive.

bbox.description: Top-left origin in the complete answer image. x+width <= 1, y+height <= 1. Width and height must be positive.

note_index.description: 1-based note/rest order in this measure; omitted in legacy records.

end_note_index.description: Last note/rest in a group, must be >= note_index.

Grading.description: AI evaluation: conditional field invariants in API-CONTRACT.md. Scores are null unless completed. No deterministic 50:50 formula in ai-melodic-v1.

CountInPlayback.description: One measure before steps 1 and 11 only. Numerator clicks at denominator-note intervals; first velocity 110, others 70. Count-in and score share one MIDI clock. 6/8 has six eighth-note clicks.

access_token.description: Opaque non-expiring token. Reused until revoked; one token per user.
